## Soft-fails / out-of-band

- Dependency install — ran `npm ci --dry-run` and `npm ls` instead of a destructive `npm ci`; the installed tree already matched the lockfile.
- `empty-database` seeding — `db init` leaves one `init` run and one run log; the evaluator truncated those in its own ephemeral DB to match the handle exactly. Not a feature defect.
- Visual review — the round Next.js dev indicator at the bottom-left of full-page screenshots overlaps content near the page bottom (for example `UI-RESPONSIVE-LAYOUT-04-bottom.png`). It is framework dev tooling outside the feature's scope and does not exist in the production build.
- Service items `SVC-API-CLIENT-01`, `-02` and `-11` need a specific process environment, so each ran in its own harness process (trailing-slash variable, variable unset, and a variable naming an unused port 8199). `stand-in-stopped` for Service was realised as a port with no listener.
- Items `UI-DASHBOARD-STATES-03/04/05`, `UI-RESPONSIVE-LAYOUT-05` ran with the stand-in process stopped by the driver and restarted for `-04`.
- No `*` flags: every `then` bullet matched a mechanical pattern or a direct DOM, request-record or process check.
